name: Sagynbay’s Manas epic narration
description: Kyrgyz epic tellers narrate and transmit extended poetic narratives; Sagynbay’s oral interpretation of Manas was recorded in writing in the 1920s.

impact.note: One teller's recorded version of an existing Kyrgyz epic; it became a reference text for one society and for later Manas editions.

date.basis: The nomination dates the transcription project to 1922–1926.

events.statement: Sagymbay Orozbakov’s oral interpretation of Manas was recorded in writing during 1922–1926.
events.scope: The date is a documentation episode, not the origin of the epic or oral performance; oral variants are distinct.

evidence.supports: UNESCO describes the oral narration and identifies the 1920s written recording of Sagynbay’s interpretation.
